# Learner Information Framework (LIF): Accelerating Education Innovation Through Data Interoperability

One-pager for enabling partners: what LIF is, why it matters, the working components it includes, and what it unlocks.

## What is LIF?

The Learner Information Framework (LIF) is an open, modular framework that enables organizations to translate fragmented learner data into portable, contextual, and holistic records. It creates an interoperable layer across disconnected systems, allowing learners to showcase their full range of experiences and enabling institutions, employers, and organizations to collaborate around shared, data-informed solutions.

## Why It Matters

- Fragmented data prevents learners from showing the full story of what they know and can do.
- Vendor lock-in and siloed systems limit innovation and collaboration.
- Equity gaps persist when only traditional credentials "count."
- Policy & program blind spots persist without connected, cross-sector data.

LIF solves this by making learner data fluid, trustworthy, and actionable across the ecosystem.

## How LIF Works

LIF provides a translation layer across multiple standards (CEDS, 1EdTech CLR/CASE, HR Open, Credential Engine, Ed-Fi, Europass, etc.). It:

- Normalizes data into a shared LIF data model.
- Supports modular adoption to avoid vendor lock-in.
- Equips learners to share holistic records via wallets, lightweight viewers, or direct exchange.
- Connects education, workforce, and employer systems with open APIs and orchestration services.

## Tangible Technology Solutions

LIF isn't just a concept — it already includes working technology components:

- **Metadata Repository** – maintains mappings and translation rules across more than a dozen standards and includes a front-end interface where individuals can align data elements of their choice without deep technical expertise.
- **Orchestrator** – fetches data across multiple source systems, assembles it, and routes it through translation pipelines.
- **Translator** – converts diverse data inputs into the standardized LIF format using configurable instructions.
- **Source System Adaptors** – connectors to common platforms (student information systems, LMS, HR systems, credentialing platforms).
- **Lightweight Viewer** – a front-end tool that enables learners and employers to view verifiable achievements and skills in a consistent format.
- **Learner Wallets & Credential Integration** – enable individuals to store and share portable records aligned with Open Badges, LER-RS, and other standards.
- **AI Tool Connector (MCP)** – enable organizations to leverage their (or connected) LIF data to inform AI agent interactions.
- **Advisor** – sample AI agent that can interact with LIF data.

These are open, extensible components that partners can adopt, extend, or integrate into their own systems without starting from scratch.

## What This Unlocks

- **Individuals:** Richer digital wallets, equitable recognition of skills, discoverability in hiring.
- **Institutions & Employers:** Improved advising, admissions, and hiring through trusted, machine-readable records.
- **Organizations & Governments:** Richer longitudinal datasets to design better supports and policies.
- **Innovators:** AI and data apps powered by higher-quality, contextualized learner information.

## Value for Enabling Partners

- Catalyze innovation with shared, open infrastructure.
- Pool learning across pilots to accelerate scaling.
- Advance equity by ensuring all learning counts.
- Strengthen the field with a common foundation for innovation.

## Join Us

LIF is a public good infrastructure for education. By contributing, piloting, or implementing, you help build the shared tools needed to transform systems—so every learner can be seen, valued, and connected to opportunity.
